name: Plate Check
description: Snap a photo of your meal and your AI estimates the calories, protein, carbs and fat. Adjust portions and track your day.
prompt: A food log powered by the AI: take a photo of a meal or type it, get each food with its portion, calories and macros, adjust portions with plus and minus, and see a daily ring with calories and protein, carbs and fat against a goal.
author: gonzaroman
